# Gnash

> Gnash is an iOS app for cutting back on nicotine — smoking, vaping, or snus — one break at a time. Instead of demanding you quit cold turkey, it helps you track your use and ease off at your own pace, accompanied by animated Moodballs.

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS (iPhone), free to download
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757307683
- Works for cigarettes, vaping, and snus
- Approach: gradual reduction at your own pace, not cold-turkey quitting
- Privacy: collects zero data — no analytics, no ads, no trackers. All data stays in the user's personal iCloud (Apple CloudKit); the developer cannot read it. See https://gnash.app/privacy.html
- Made by Caglar Araz

## Pages

- [Home](https://gnash.app/): App overview and App Store download link
- [Privacy Policy](https://gnash.app/privacy.html): Full privacy policy — zero data collection, iCloud-only storage, user-controlled deletion
